claims.assertion: Za’el says he lived on Erra in Taygeta and has incomplete past-life memories that give him affection for people he has not met in this incarnation.
claims.speaker: Za’el de Erra
claims.qualifiers: He says his memories are incomplete.

claims.assertion: He enjoys some Earth art and entertainment but does not wish to live there again, advising people to interpret media personally and notice attached agendas.
claims.speaker: Za’el de Erra

claims.assertion: Za’el describes himself as emotionally intense but reserved, analytical, and slow to conclusions; he values honesty and honorable conduct partly for self-protection.
claims.speaker: Za’el de Erra
